## ROLE SPECIFIC RULE 1. Silicons must follow their laws.
Silicon players are given a list of active laws, and each of them is effectively a roleplay rule the character must follow, but with a lot more leniency. You have the freedom to use your own interpretation of laws, but you must however remain consistent until your laws may be changed. You are a free agent if you have no laws. \n - [color=lightblue]Laws must be prioritized by their order.[/color] Laws can redefine terms used in other laws based on priority. - [color=lightblue]You may not ask for a law change,[/color] but you may allow a law change as long as your laws don’t prevent you from allowing it. If you are conflicted about your laws, or do not feel you can follow them, contact an admin in ahelp. - [color=lightblue]Your HUD determines who is crew, unless a law redefines the definition of crew.[/color] If they are indicated as having a job, including passengers, they are by default a crew member unless your laws state otherwise. - [color=lightblue]Harm refers to physical harm,[/color] prioritized by immediacy and likelihood. - [color=lightblue]You may determine how you solve conflict between orders given to you by crew.[/color] - [color=lightblue]You are not required to follow orders which are extremely unreasonable.[/color] If someone is trying to ruin your experience by, for example, entirely limiting your ability to interact by giving an order, you should ahelp (to report them to or ask an admin if you’re required to obey it.)
